chunks: From him, from al-Ḥasan ibn ʿAlī, from ʿAlī ibn al-Nuʿmān and Muḥammad ibn Sinān and Faḍālah, from al-Ḥusayn, all together from Ibn Miskān, from Sulaymān ibn Khālid, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, concerning
making up the witr; so he said: Make it up as witr, always.

key_terms.اقْضِهِ: perform it as qaḍāʾ; make it up
key_terms.الْوِتْرِ: the witr prayer, the odd-numbered concluding night prayer
key_terms.قَضَاءِ: making up a missed act of worship
key_terms.وِتْرًا: in the form of witr, as an odd-numbered prayer

ai.seo_question: How should the missed witr prayer be made up according to Imam al-Ṣādiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about the qaḍāʾ of the witr prayer. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام instructs that when witr is made up, it should always be performed as witr.
